meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.15.18
§ Ben = "son"
a Levite, one of the porters appointed by David for the ark

elsewhere.note: and with them their brothers of the second rank, Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu…
